meta.problem:
Brad is the quarterback of his school's football team. In the first half of one game, he completed three of the six passes he threw, or 3/6 of his passes. Show this value on the number line.
What is the fraction in the problem?

hintsPerCorrectStep: Enter 3 in the box.
Enter 6 in the box.
If you want to convert the fraction to a mixed number, click "Convert", if not, simply click on the number line to place your fraction to complete the problem.
Please provide your answer 'No_Value' in the highlighted element.
Please provide your answer 'No_Value' in the highlighted element.
Convert the improper fraction on the left into a mixed number, and enter the integer part of the mixed number into this box.
What is the maximum number of 6/6 that can fit into 3/6?
You can also find this out by dividing the numerator by the denominator, and see how many times 6 fits into 3.
Please enter '0' in the highlighted field.
Convert the improper fraction on the left into a mixed number, and enter the numerator part into this box.
Numerator of the mixed number is the remainder of the division between the numerator and the denominator of the improper fraction!
Divide 3 by 6. What is its remainder?
Please enter '-' in the highlighted field.
Convert the improper fraction on the left into a mixed number, and enter the denominator part into this box.
Did you know that conversion between mixed number from improper fraction never changes the denominator?
Please enter '-' in the highlighted field.
Click on the spot where you would find 3/6.
Imagine the number line being divided into 6 parts.
Think of it this way: 3/6 is an equivalent fraction of 1/2, which lays right in the middle of the line.
